rules: Raw images, archives, API responses, and download receipts stay below ml/data/ and are ignored by Git.
A repository licence is not proof that every upstream image is cleared for commercial model training.
Only immutable dataset versions are accepted; HTTP files receive local SHA-256 and byte-count receipts, while Git sources receive a commit plus deterministic tree SHA-256 and total bytes.
Generated or augmented images must never cross train, validation, or test groups independently of their originals.

sources.title: Dataset for Crop Pest and Disease Detection (CCMT raw field images)
provenance_warnings: Keep capture-near-duplicates and all transformations of an original in one split group.
The raw branch also includes cashew and cassava; use those only as wrong-crop/OOD exposure for the current product scope.
Geography differs from Nepal; it is field-domain training data, not a Nepal validation set.

acquisition.selection_reason: Use the 24,881 captured originals only; never download the 102,976-image augmented branch.

sources.title: TOM2024 original crop images (Category A only)
provenance_warnings: Category B contains derived data; only Category A is admitted to the acquisition set.
Category A includes maize, onion, and tomato disease and pest branches; onion and non-target pests are OOD/other exposure for the current product scope, not target disease labels.
Review class translations and collapse only labels that are agronomically equivalent.

acquisition.selection_reason: Fetch the publisher's immutable English Category A archive directly; Category B is never acquired.

sources.title: PLDD-UP: Potato Leaf Disease Dataset from Uttar Pradesh, India
provenance_warnings: Capture bursts can leak nearly identical leaves across random splits; group by perceptual similarity and session where recoverable.

sources.title: Central Java potato leaf field dataset
provenance_warnings: Hold out farms or collection sessions if metadata permits; do not rely on the publisher split without duplicate checks.

sources.title: Potato Leaf Disease Dataset (Bangladesh)
provenance_warnings: Use originals only where the archive distinguishes originals from augmented derivatives.
All augmented descendants must inherit the original image's split group.

sources.title: Maize Dataset (PlantVillage-style lab derivative)
geography: controlled/background-isolated imagery; exact upstream provenance unresolved
provenance_warnings: CONTENT AUDIT: despite the field-oriented description, the archive contains PlantVillage-style 256x256 filenames and images; treat it as a lab derivative, not field evidence.
The archive contains four maize directories (282 CGLS, 538 rust, 430 healthy, 342 NLB) plus unexpected pepper disease (301) and pepper healthy (446) directories.
Use maize images for warm-start training only and pepper as optional non-maize exposure; never use any of this archive for field validation or Nepal claims.
Resolve the exact upstream-image provenance before commercial release even though the Figshare record states CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Tomato Leaf Disease Classification Dataset (Bangladesh)
provenance_warnings: Version 2 is intentional; class counts and labels must be taken from the downloaded immutable version, not cached Version 1 descriptions.

sources.title: Tomato field images with bounding-box annotations
provenance_warnings: Bounding boxes can support leaf/lesion localization, but image-level disease labels must not be inferred unless the annotation schema explicitly supplies them.

sources.title: PlantDoc field-image dataset
provenance_warnings: LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: the repository licence does not establish that each scraped source image was licensed for redistribution or commercial model training.
Internet search results are duplicate-prone and can overlap benchmarks; apply exact/perceptual deduplication before any split.
Do not use PlantDoc as the sole field test set or as evidence of Nepal performance.

sources.title: PlantVillage dataset mirror/version

license.name: Resolve the version-specific licence before training

provenance_warnings: LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: CC0 claims attached to other PlantVillage distributions must not be assumed to cover this exact Mendeley version.
Controlled backgrounds create a large field-domain gap and inflated random-split metrics.
If cleared, use only for pretraining; exclude from the field validation and field test evidence.

sources.title: PlantCity: Multi-crop leaf disease images from Pakistan (Version 2)
provenance_warnings: REVIEW REQUIRED: the publisher reports 10,667 collected images but 52,219 images after augmentation; the two provider archives are named train.zip and test.zip, and their internal original-to-derivative lineage has not been verified.
Do not admit this source until the archives are inspected. Prefer verified originals only; if a derivative is retained, it must inherit its source image's split group.
Do not trust the publisher train/test boundary as an independent evaluation split until exact and perceptual duplicate checks prove that no original or capture-near-duplicate crosses it.
Only maize and tomato are in the present product taxonomy; all other species require explicit wrong-crop/OOD mapping rather than disease-label coercion.
Pakistan field imagery improves regional diversity but is not evidence of performance in Nepal.

acquisition.selection_reason: Registered for manual archive and lineage review; no include/exclude path is asserted because the provider exposes only train.zip and test.zip and their internal augmentation layout is unverified.

sources.title: Tomato leaf diseases field images from Bangladesh (Version 1)
geography: Khagan and Charabag, Savar, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh
provenance_warnings: COUNT MISMATCH: the published class counts sum to 2,659, while the public provider folder tree exposes 2,627 image files; the reported 32-image uncategorized Class 16 is not visible as a folder. Reconcile the downloaded immutable version before admission.

The description says images were reduced in size by 80% and also mentions preprocessing and augmentation without identifying derivative lineage; do not assume every file is a distinct camera original.
Group exact/perceptual duplicates and any recovered transformations by original capture before assigning splits.
Several labels describe pests or generic damage rather than diseases, and Leaf Mold versus Cercospora leaf mold may be taxonomically ambiguous; require agronomic label review before mapping.
The stated collection location and the broader claim of samples from varied regions are not reconciled in the record; do not infer farm-independent coverage or Nepal validity.

acquisition.selection_reason: Registered for count, lineage, duplicate and taxonomy review; no originals-only path is claimed by the publisher metadata.

sources.title: Seasonal Corn Leaf Disease Dataset from Bangladesh (Version 1)
geography: Gurudaspur, Natore District, Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh
provenance_warnings: REVIEW REQUIRED: the publisher reports 2,943 originals and 7,500 augmented images, but exposes one Corn leaf disease dataset.zip archive whose internal originals/augmentation layout and lineage are unverified.
Admit verified originals only unless every augmented file can inherit its original capture's split group; never randomly split the combined archive.
The wording does not establish whether 7,500 means derivative images alone or the post-augmentation total; verify archive counts rather than deriving a total.

The title claims a multi-year collection and the record says environmental metadata exists; preserve year, farm, session and capture-near-duplicate groups for site/time holdouts if those fields are actually present.
Bangladesh field imagery is useful regional evidence but cannot substitute for a locked Nepal evaluation set.

acquisition.selection_reason: Registered for manual archive and lineage review; no originals-only include path is asserted because the single archive's internal layout is unverified.

sources.title: Tomato Leaf Disease Classification Dataset from Bangladesh (Version 1)
provenance_warnings: VERSION ISOLATION REQUIRED: Version 1 is registered separately from the existing Version 2 source. Do not merge versions until file hashes, perceptual duplicates and version lineage are audited.
The record describes multiple regions but does not provide farm or session identifiers in its summary; infer neither farm independence nor a valid geographic holdout without inspecting metadata.
Leaf miner flies and magnesium deficiency are not interchangeable with named infectious diseases; map them only through explicit pest/deficiency or other-unknown taxonomy states.
Images were collected within an eleven-day window, so capture bursts and repeated leaves must remain in one split group.
Bangladesh evidence cannot establish performance for Nepal.

acquisition.selection_reason: Registered as an immutable historical version for lineage and duplicate review, not as an automatic supplement to Version 2.

sources.title: MLD: Multi-Class Maize Leaf Disease Image Dataset from Bangladesh (Version 1)
geography: Jhenaidah District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh (23.54498 N, 89.15321 E)
provenance_warnings: The publisher reports HEIF/JPG camera images converted to JPG where necessary and resized to 640x480; treat converted or resized variants of one capture as one provenance group if multiple representations are present.
The eight-day, single-orchard capture window is vulnerable to burst and plant-level leakage; group by capture sequence and plant/session where recoverable before splitting.
Fall armyworm is pest damage, not a disease class, while Blight and Gray Spot are underspecified names; require agronomic label normalization rather than forcing them into more specific diagnoses.
Inspect the single Maize dataset.zip archive and reconcile exactly 1,996 decodable, unique admitted images before use.
One Bangladesh orchard is valuable field-domain training data but is neither a Nepal validation set nor broad farm-level evidence.

acquisition.selection_reason: Registered for archive, duplicate, grouping and taxonomy review before any manifest admission.

sources.title: Tomato Leaf Image Dataset for Disease Analysis in Real-World Environment
provenance_warnings: LOCKED HOLDOUT: binary healthy/diseased labels are useful for independent gating evaluation but not for disease-name supervision.
Do not inspect or train on the locked holdout while selecting models or thresholds.

sources.title: DigiGreen/Crop_Disease_Images
provenance_warnings: LOCKED HOLDOUT: never train on, tune thresholds against, or inspect this source during model selection.
Access only for a pre-registered final evaluation and retain the pinned repository commit in the receipt.

sources.title: Open Images V7 object-focused candidates for manual non-plant review

license.name: Pixels listed per image as CC BY 2.0; Google annotations CC BY 4.0; individual verification required

provenance_warnings: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED: image-level annotations are not exhaustive, so automated filtering cannot establish that a frame is non-plant.
Never map a staged candidate to non_plant or include it in a model manifest until a human has reviewed the complete frame.
Exclude any visible person, face, plant, crop, tree, flower, leaf, food, or ambiguous organic material during manual review.
Open Images disclaims warranties about image licence status; retain author, original landing URL and per-image licence metadata and verify them before release.

sources.title: PlantWild / PlantWild_v2
provenance_warnings: EXCLUDED: the non-commercial and no-derivatives restrictions are incompatible with the intended product-training workflow.
